title_zh: 微笑的拓扑结构：牙科影像中的持久同调
title_en: Topology of a Smile: Persistent Homology in Dental Imaging
summary_zh: 锥形束计算机断层扫描（CBCT）提供详细的三维图像，广泛应用于牙科诊断和治疗规划。虽然价值巨大，但分析和记录这些扫描过程劳动强度大，因此推动自动化关键步骤，如解剖结构的分类和分割，以识别牙齿类型及相关病变。本文提出一种利用持久同调（一种拓扑数据分析框架，可识别多尺度上的连通分量、孔洞和空洞等形状特征）的自动化方法。结合支持向量机，我们实现了CBCT中牙齿的分类及诊断。该方法达到牙齿标注平均准确率97.67%，诊断任务96.77%，显著优于同一数据训练的卷积神经网络（准确率分别为70.27%和86.67%）。
summary_en: Cone Beam Computed Tomography (CBCT) provides detailed 3D images widely used in dentistry for diagnosis and treatment planning. Analyzing and documenting these scans is labor-intensive, motivating automation of key steps like classification and segmentation of anatomical structures to identify tooth types and pathologies. This article proposes an automation approach leveraging persistent homology, a topological data analysis method that studies shapes by identifying features such as connected components, holes, and voids across multiple scales. Combined with a support vector machine, this approach classifies teeth and performs diagnostics in CBCT scans. The method achieves average accuracies of 97.67% for tooth labeling and 96.77% for diagnostics, outperforming a CNN trained on the same data with accuracies of 70.27% and 86.67%, respectively.
why_it_matters_zh: 该研究展示了拓扑数据分析中的持久同调在牙科三维影像分类与诊断中的有效应用，显著提升自动化诊断准确率，推动牙科影像技术的发展。
why_it_matters_en: This study demonstrates the effective application of persistent homology from topological data analysis in 3D dental image classification and diagnostics, significantly improving automation accuracy and advancing dental imaging technology.

title_zh: EditStream：用于交互式视频生成与编辑的统一自回归框架
title_en: EditStream: A Unified Autoregressive Framework for Interactive Video Generation and Editing
summary_zh: 交互式视频生成和编辑在创意设计中日益重要。本文介绍了EditStream，一个统一的交互式视频生成与编辑框架。EditStream通过灵活的任务特定条件，将多种视频创建和操作任务整合到单一基于DiT的模型中，并转化为快速的少步自回归模型以实现高效流式处理。该系统支持文本到视频、图像到视频、视频到视频、编辑传播、参考引导的视频编辑及摄像机姿态变化，实现对视频生成、转换和编辑的灵活控制。为实现交互式使用，设计了结合速度矩匹配（VMM）与自回归展开的两阶段蒸馏方法，有效提升生成质量、运动连续性和时间稳定性，解决了视频生成中的过饱和、运动退化和训练复杂性等挑战。EditStream为高质量的基于扩散的视频模型与创意工作流的结合提供了实用且可扩展的解决方案。
summary_en: Interactive video generation and editing are increasingly important for creative design. EditStream is introduced as a unified framework that consolidates multiple video creation and manipulation tasks into a single DiT-based model with flexible task-specific conditioning. It transforms into a fast, few-step autoregressive model for efficient streaming, supporting Text-to-Video, Image-to-Video, Video-to-Video, Editing Propagation, Reference-guided Editing, and Camera Pose Changes. To make it practical for interactive use, a two-stage distillation combining Velocity Moment Matching (VMM) with autoregressive unrolling is developed, preserving quality, motion, and temporal stability while addressing common challenges such as oversaturation and motion degradation. EditStream presents a practical, scalable approach bridging high-quality diffusion video models and interactive creative workflows.
why_it_matters_zh: EditStream创新性地将多任务视频生成与编辑整合于同一模型，通过高效的自回归机制实现实时交互应用，解决了传统视频生成存在的质量和稳定性问题，推动视频生成技术更广泛的应用和实用化。
why_it_matters_en: EditStream innovatively unifies multiple video generation and editing tasks within a single model and employs an efficient autoregressive approach for real-time interactive use. It addresses key challenges in video generation quality and stability, advancing the practical and broader application of video generation technology.

title_zh: KVBoost：基于偏差引导重新计算的块级键值缓存重用，提高大语言模型推理效率
title_en: KVBoost: Chunk-Level Key-Value Cache Reuse with Deviation-Guided Recomputation for Efficient Large Language Model Inference
summary_zh: KVBoost是一种面向HuggingFace兼容解码器模型的块级键值缓存重用系统，支持无论内容位置，实现键值缓存的高效复用。通过双哈希键设计分离位置信息和内容信息，支持准确及近似缓存匹配。针对缓存块边界的注意力错误，KVBoost提出有选择的重新计算与缓存混合重新计算策略，并结合非对称量化、适应性块边界划分和重要性加权驱逐，在维持99.2%准确率的同时，将首次生成延迟降低4.49倍，优于传统前缀缓存方案。该系统无需架构修改，实现在RoPE模型上的内存受限推理加速。
summary_en: KVBoost is a chunk-level key-value cache reuse system for HuggingFace-compatible decoder models that enables efficient reuse regardless of content position by employing a dual-hash scheme separating positional and content identity. It introduces strategies like SelectiveRecompute and CacheBlendRecompute to fix attention errors at chunk boundaries and incorporates asymmetric quantization, adaptive chunk splitting, and importance-weighted eviction. Evaluations show a 4.49x reduction in time-to-first-token over baseline and a 16% improvement over prefix caching without accuracy loss, providing a practical memory-bounded inference acceleration compatible with RoPE-based models without architectural changes.
why_it_matters_zh: 此研究提出的新缓存重用方案显著提升了变换器大语言模型推理速度，解决了传统前缀缓存方法对共享内容位置的限制问题，具有重要的性能及实用价值。
why_it_matters_en: The research introduces a novel cache reuse method that substantially accelerates transformer LLM inference by overcoming the positional constraints of existing prefix caching, offering significant practical improvements in efficiency without accuracy degradation.
